mechanism_narrative: A rise in GDP above its 6-month moving average indicates increasing economic activity, which boosts consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of GDP growth above its 6-month moving average (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases borrowing costs and reduces consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate above 5% indicates a weakening labor market, which reduces consumer spending and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of high unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts rise above their 3-month moving average and GDP growth is positive, it indicates a strong demand environment that boosts consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong demand (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below its 6-month moving average indicates reduced supply chain activity, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of declining industrial production (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is below 2% and the CPI is rising, it signals an inflationary environment that erodes purchasing power and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of low interest rates and rising inflation (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in payroll employment above its 3-month moving average indicates a strong labor market, which boosts consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong labor market growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales rise above their 6-month moving average and the unemployment rate is below 5%, it indicates a strong demand environment that boosts consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong demand (t-test p > 0.05).
